title: crypto2dev_ecdsa hash-algo inference from digest length should be in a comment visible from sign/verify callsites
description: crypto2dev_ecdsa_hash_algo_name() has an excellent comment (L1258-1271) explaining why SHA-3 is excluded and why length inference works only for P-256/P-384/P-521. But the comment is on the helper function, not at the two callsites in crypto2dev_ecdsa(). A future contributor adding SHA-3 support will likely modify crypto2dev_ecdsa() first and may not read the helper's comment before adding a 32-byte SHA3-256 case. Add a one-line callsite comment: 'digest length → SHA algo: see crypto2dev_ecdsa_hash_algo_name() comment for SHA-3 exclusion'.
